_note: THE LAST SIGNAL (script v3, locked). shots[] = the ~40 CUTS in script order; each cut is pulled from a RENDER (renders.json). Several half-second cuts come from one 5s render. beat = one-frame visible state for beat_gate; clip_beat = what stays true over the clip.

spine.beat: a spaceship is in danger, racing through an asteroid field
a woman captain is at the controls under red alarms
the ship plunges into an orange lightning storm
the ship is colossal, city-sized, and arrives over an alien plain
the ship lands hard on black glass
the plain is covered with endless carved monoliths
the captain and her crewmate walk among the monoliths
the captain's touch makes a carved symbol glow, and she recognizes it
every monolith lights up in a wave across the planet
the captain stands frozen as the planet speaks to her
the planet attacks: second sun, crewmate taken, engines destroyed, a colossal shape rises
the captain runs for her life
something huge grabs the ship as it tries to leave
